narrative.overview: Military Suite is a dense administrative event log and historical reporting tool built for scanability and high-zoom stability.
keyCharacteristics: Flat matte surfaces (#111418 / #181c22 / #20262f) without shadows, blur, or gradients
1px hairline Paper-Rule dividers (#2b3340) instead of nested cards
Sharp 0px / 2px geometry and mandatory tabular-nums on all metrics and dates
Calm Ukrainian administrative terminology with SVG icons only

rules.name: Flat Matte Elevation
rules.body: Never use backdrop-blur, box-shadow glows, or hover transform jumps.

rules.name: Tabular Precision
rules.body: All counters, tables, ratios, coordinates, and timestamps use tabular-nums.

dos: Provide explicit aria-label and focus-visible (#4c8ed9) outlines on interactive controls
Ensure toolbars wrap cleanly at 125-175% browser zoom without viewport clipping
Use overscroll-behavior: contain on modals and drawers
donts: Don't use rounded-xl/2xl, nested cards, or gradient fills/text
Don't use emoji characters in place of SVG icons
Don't modify administrative schemas, fields, or saved records during UI updates
